title: Fix the Copy-Pasted Getter
description: The program should have separate getters for width and height that each return the correct field.
expectedBehavior: getHeight() should return 9, the rectangle's height.
actualProblem: getHeight() was likely copy-pasted from getWidth() and never updated — it returns width instead of height, so r.getHeight() incorrectly prints 4.
explanation: Each getter method must return the field matching its own name and purpose. Copy-pasting one getter to create another is a common source of this kind of bug if the returned field isn't also updated.
